To stir up or excite; to rouse or goad into action.

examples.text: The judge was told by the accused that his friends had incited him to commit the crime.
incite people to violence
Human rights groups blame the anti-Rohingya propaganda for inciting murders, rapes and the largest forced human migration in recent history.

glosses: To bring about by urging or encouraging.

examples.text: to instigate a riot
to instigate a change

examples.text: to instigate someone to a crime
